LESSON: PHONOLOGICAL AWARENESS

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ARABIC
Strand: Listening and Speaking
Topic 1.3: Phonological Awareness
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Phonological Awareness, part of Listening and Speaking in Grade 7 ARABIC.

Key inquiry question: What can you do to improve your ability to pronounce words accurately?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to audio-visual recordings about the market using digital devices,

2. identify vocabulary related to the theme used in the recording,

3. work jointly to practise pronouncing the words accurately,

4. role-play a market scene involving buying and selling of items,

5. use appropriate stress and intonation to express themselves in the role-play.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to audio-visual recordings about the market using digital devices,
2. identify vocabulary related to the theme used in the recording,
3. work jointly to practise pronouncing the words accurately,
4. role-play a market scene involving buying and selling of items,
5. use appropriate stress and intonation to express themselves in the role-play.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Phonological Awareness together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Digital Literacy: This is promoted as the learner interacts with digital content when listening to audio-visual recordings

about the market.

• Creativity and Imagination: This is enhanced as the learner embraces creative ideas when role-playing a market scene

involving buying and selling of items.
